system.description:
You have gained the wisdom of elders, whether through your own experiences or by learning from their instruction.

Prerequisite: Skill Focus (Knowledge (Galactic Lore)) or Skill Focus (Knowledge (Social Sciences))

Effect: Once per encounter, you can substitute a Knowledge (Galactic Lore) or Knowledge (Social Sciences) check for a Wisdom or Wisdom-related check.
